strings.未加载 — 先选模组目录点「加载 / 提取」: Not loaded — pick a mod folder and click "Load / Extract"
strings.就绪 | 提示: Vortex 用户应用后需在 Vortex 中重新 Deplo: Ready | Tip: re-Deploy in Vortex after applying
strings.语言包 %d 行 / 设置与源码 %d 行: Locale pack %d rows / settings & source %d rows
strings.其中长句 %d 条, 关掉「长句兜底」可只看界面文本: %d long sentences — turn off "Long-sentence fallback" to see UI text only
strings.需为 OpenAI 兼容接口(带 /v1)；留空表示暂不启用机器翻译。: Must be an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (with /v1). Leave empty to disable machine translation.
strings.连接成功 (HTTP %s)，但未解析到模型列表: Connected (HTTP %s), but no model list was returned
strings.连接失败: %s（服务没启动或地址不对）: Connection failed: %s (service not running or wrong address)
strings.1. 选择模组目录 → 加载/提取\n: 1. Pick a mod folder → Load / Extract
strings.2. 在「译文」列双击填中文\n: 2. Double-click the Translation column and type
strings.3. 点「应用到模组」（自动备份 .bak）\n: 3. Click "Apply to mod" (.bak backups are automatic)
strings.设置菜单可配置本地部署模型的 API 地址。: The Settings menu configures the local model API endpoint.
strings.选择模组目录(或直接选 Vortex 下的整个文件夹): Select a mod folder (or the whole Vortex folder)
strings.请先选择有效的模组目录: Choose a valid mod folder first
strings.。双击「译文」列填入中文，完成后点「应用到模组」。: . Double-click the Translation column, then click "Apply to mod".
strings.表格只显示前 %d 条，请用筛选/搜索缩小范围。: Only the first %d rows are shown — narrow the filter/search.
strings.结果 %d 条，表格只显示前 %d 条 —— 请用上方「筛选/搜索」缩小范围: %d results; showing the first %d — narrow it with Filter/Search
strings.表格是空的，先加载模组目录。: The table is empty. Load a mod folder first.
strings.还没有填写本地模型 API 地址。\n现在打开设置吗?:
No local model API endpoint is set.
Open settings now?
strings.正在批量机翻, 请稍候: Batch translation is running, please wait
strings.先在表格里选中一行。: Select a row in the table first.
strings.机翻完成: %d 条。请逐条检查后再点「应用到模组」。: Done: %d row(s). Review them, then click "Apply to mod".
strings.先在表格里点一行: Click a row in the table first
strings.选中一行后在里输入译文, 回车确认并跳到下一行: Select a row, type the translation, press Enter to confirm and move on
Model output was not valid JSON; translating one by one ...
strings.将把 %d 条译文写回模组源文件 %s\n(自动创建 .bak 备份，可随时恢复:
Write %d translation(s) into %s
(.bak backups are created automatically).
strings.%d 条译文已写回模组。\nVortex 用户请重新 Deploy 后启动游戏。:
%d translation(s) written.
Re-Deploy in Vortex before launching the game.
strings.机翻完成: %d 条（其中 %d 条来自翻译记忆）。请逐条检查后再点「应用到模组: Done: %d row(s), %d from memory. Review them, then click "Apply to mod".
strings.术语表(每行 原文=译文，可用 # 注释): Glossary (one  source=target  per line, # for comments)
strings.文本来源: REDscript(.reds) / 输入 XML / CET Lu: Sources: REDscript (.reds) / input XML / CET Lua (.lua)
strings.[提示] 该模组有 %d 个语言包 json，文本在 json 里，本工具暂: [Note] This mod has %d locale JSON file(s); their text is not extracted yet.
strings.已跳过 %d 个语言包文件(勾选「语言包文件」可提取)。: Skipped %d locale file(s) (enable "Locale files" to include them).
strings.该模组没有找到语言包文件: No locale files found in this mod
strings.从已有语言包提取原文, 翻译后生成新的目标语言文件(不改动源文件)。: Extract source text from an existing locale file, then generate a new target-language file (the source is left untouched).
strings.这一行还没有译文。: This row has no translation yet.
strings.清空这一行的译文？\n原文和模组文件都不会改动，只是把已填的译文去掉。:
Clear this row's translation?
The source text and mod files stay untouched.
strings.当前筛选没有可重翻的行。: The current filter has no rows to re-translate.
strings.重新翻译当前筛选的 %d 行？\n会覆盖这些行现有的译文，且不查官方基线与翻译记:
Re-translate the %d filtered rows?
This overwrites their current translations and skips the official baseline and translation memory.
strings.当前范围内没有已翻译的行: No translated rows in the current scope
strings.将把 %d 条译文打包成一个新的翻译 mod。\n产物写到该 mod 的 .ar:
Package %d translation(s) into a new translation mod.
It will be written next to the mod's .archive (the original archive is untouched).
strings.Vortex 用户请重新 Deploy 后启动游戏。: Vortex users: re-deploy before launching the game.
strings.所选文件都是当前目标语言，已跳过。请选择源语言文件。: All selected files are in the current target language and were skipped. Choose a source-language file.
strings.没有可提取的原文（已跳过 %d 条目标语言文本）: No extractable source text (%d target-language text(s) skipped)
strings.没有单条失败明细；请查看文件级错误。: No per-item failure details; see file-level errors.
strings.目标 JSON 中找不到对应 key: Corresponding key not found in the target JSON
strings.多语言替换表 %d 项，仅提取目标语言 %d 项: Multi-language replacement table: %d pair(s), only %d target-language item(s) extracted
strings.多语言替换表: 识别 %d 项，仅提取目标语言 %d 项: Multi-language replacement table: %d pair(s) detected, only %d target-language item(s) extracted
strings.跳过此文件所有行: Skip all rows in this file
strings.恢复此文件所有行: Restore all rows in this file
strings.此行已跳过翻译: This row is marked as skipped.
strings.清空当前提取结果中的全部译文？\n原文和表格行会保留，模组文件不会修改。:
Clear all translations in the current extraction?
Source text and rows will remain. Mod files will not be modified.
strings.已清空当前提取结果的全部译文（模组文件未修改）。: Cleared all translations in the current extraction (mod files unchanged).
strings.清空当前提取结果和全部译文？\n这不会修改模组文件，模组目录会保留。:
Clear the current extraction results and all translations?
This will not modify mod files; the mod folder will be kept.
strings.已清空当前提取结果（模组文件未修改）。: Cleared current extraction results (mod files unchanged).
strings.已跳过 %d 条内容；机翻和应用时都会忽略。: Skipped %d item(s); they will be ignored by machine translation and apply.
strings.已跳过此文件 %d 条内容；机翻和应用时都会忽略。: Skipped %d item(s) in this file; they will be ignored by machine translation and apply.
strings.已恢复此文件 %d 条内容的翻译。: Restored translation for %d item(s) in this file.
strings.模组里本来就是这个语言的文本。改译文列即可覆盖。: This text is already in the target language inside the mod. Edit the translation column to override it.
strings.已跳过 %d 条目标语言文本（其中 %d 条已译，已列在表里）: Skipped %d target-language text(s) (%d already translated, listed in the table)
strings.没有可用于撤销的模组目录: No mod folder available for undo
strings.已撤销上次应用，恢复 %d 个文件。: Undid the last apply; restored %d file(s).
strings.已撤销上次应用，恢复 %d 个文件。Vortex 用户请重新 Deploy。: Undid the last apply; restored %d file(s). Vortex users must re-Deploy.
strings.来源：本地快照（没找到可用的下载包）: Source: local snapshots (no usable download package)
strings.归档已不在原位置: %s: The archive is no longer at its original location: %s
strings.来源：无（只删除本工具新建的文件）: Source: none (only files created by this tool will be deleted)
strings.删除 %d 个新建文件: delete %d file(s) created by this tool
strings.把这个模组还原成未翻译前的样子？: Revert this mod to its pre-translation state?
strings.还原后会先拍一张快照，仍可用「撤销上次应用」退回还原前的状态。: A snapshot is taken first, so "Undo last apply" can still bring the translated state back.
strings.已还原 %d 个文件，模组回到翻译前的状态。Vortex 用户请重新 Deplo: Reverted %d file(s); the mod is back to its pre-translation state. Vortex users must re-Deploy before launching.
strings.撤销最近一次应用到模组？\n时间: %s\n将恢复 %d 个文件，本次新建的目标:
Undo the most recent apply to the mod?
Time: %s
%d file(s) will be restored; target files created by that apply will be deleted.
strings.Vortex 活动映射：安装缓存目录是工具实际改写的文件（Vortex 用硬链接: Vortex activity map: the staging folder is what this tool rewrites (Vortex hardlinks it into the game folder); the downloads folder is read-only and tells which version is installed.
strings.加载时提示该目录是否生效: Warn when the folder is not deployed
strings.点一行把该目录填到「模组目录」；双击直接加载。: Click a row to put that folder in “Mod folder”; double-click to load it.
strings.点「继续翻译剩下的」只补这 %d 行，已经翻好的不会重来。: “Translate the rest” retries only these %d rows; finished ones are kept.
strings.已手动停止，剩下的还没有翻译: Stopped manually; the rest is untranslated
strings.已填入探测到的目录，确认后点「保存」: Filled in the detected folders; press Save to keep them.
strings.没探测到 Vortex 目录，请手动填写: No Vortex folder detected — please fill it in manually
strings.请先在设置里填写「安装缓存目录」与「下载包目录」: Please set the staging and downloads folders in Settings first
strings.映射模块加载失败：%s: Failed to load the mapping module: %s
strings.未生效：该目录不在 Vortex 部署清单里: Not live: this folder is not in Vortex's deployment manifest
strings.这个目录没有生效（Vortex 没把它部署进游戏）。\n改动写入后游戏读不到——:
This folder is not live (Vortex never deployed it into the game).
Changes will not be read by the game — Deploy in Vortex first, or load the live version instead.
strings.官方双语语料（基线 TM）：把官方语言包按主键对齐，得到游戏自己的 en→zh: Official bilingual corpus (baseline TM): aligned by key from the official language packs, yielding the game's own en→zh translations. It sits before machine memory — a hit is used as-is and never sent to the model.
strings.作为基线优先套用（手改 > 官方 > 机翻）: Use as baseline first (your edits > official > machine)
strings.单词条的官方命中也算（标「待核」，可单独筛选复核）: Also accept single-word official hits (marked “check”, filterable)
strings.当前目标语言不套用：%s: not applied for this target language: %s
strings.官方语料只有英文→简体中文，目标语言是「%s」时不套用: the corpus is English→Simplified Chinese only, so it is skipped for “%s”
strings.已关闭「加载时套用官方语料」: “Use official corpus as baseline” is off
strings.同一句原文只翻一次，重复的 %d 行直接复用。: each source string is sent once; %d duplicate rows reuse the same translation.
strings.正在载入本地模型（首次约需 1 分钟）…: loading the local model (about a minute the first time)…
strings.有 %d 批没翻成（共 %d 条），可以直接再点一次补翻: %d batches failed (%d lines); click translate again to retry them
strings.启用本地模型(停用后不再走机翻，并释放显存): Enable local model (off: no machine translation, frees VRAM)
strings.操作失败：后端没有响应: Action failed: no response from the backend
strings.这 %d 条归档行都没有条目 ID，无法定位到归档里的条目。请重新加载该模组后再: These %d archive rows have no entry ID, so no archive entry can be located. Reload the mod before applying again.
strings.还没有选择任何行，先点一行再试: No row is selected yet; click a row first
strings.这一行正被筛选或隐藏，先恢复显示才能定位: This row is filtered/hidden; restore it before jumping
strings.选中的行已被筛选/隐藏，已取消选择: The selected row was filtered/hidden; selection cleared
strings.%d 句同时出现在明文与归档里: %d string(s) appear in both plaintext and archive
strings.本地模型已停用。在设置里重新启用后再翻译。: The local model is disabled. Re-enable it in Settings before translating.
strings.将提交 %d 条译文：%d 条打包成新的翻译 mod，其余写回源文件。\n原 m:
Submit %d translation(s): %d go into a new translation mod, the rest are written back to source files.
The original mod is not modified.
strings.翻译物已生成：%s（在输出目录，未安装）: Translation package created: %s (in the output folder, not installed)
